title: Xoroth
wikitext:
One of the firey, chaotic worlds belonging to the [[Burning Legion]], or more specifically, the [[Nathrezim]] (Dreadlords). This is home to the infernal [[Dreadsteed]]s, mounts to the Dreadlords. They are owned by [[Lord Hel'nurath]], the "stable keeper". You will have to summon a Dreadsteed in a quest for a [[warlock]]'s [[epic]] [[mount]] by opening a portal to this world in [[Dire Maul]].
